content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education International Pathways Abroad Studying abroad Double & Joint Degrees Double & Joint Degrees In addition to the variety of student exchange opportunities at one of HTW Berlin's around 150 partner universities, students of certain study programs are also able to take part in special Double Degree programs. Detailled information on the various Double Degree programs can be obtained on the website of the responsible faculty: Additional information Double Degree agreements are conceived in a way that enables students inegrated and coordinated studies both at their home as well as at their host university, without an unnnecessary extension of their period of study. Thus, students are provided with the opportunity to gain valuable international experience, improve their intercultural and linguistic skills and broaden their horizon by obtaining unique perspectives within both partner countries. All aforementioned aspects significantly increase the employability of Double Degree graduates and prepare them for the diverse demands of the modern working world in the most optimal way.
